answer: Jurors stake 6% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The summit panel is drawn blind, the onyx escrow settles at close, and hollow lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 318 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
